recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a narrow correction to a current source example in an active resource folder; no further core source change is recommended for FHIR-20594.
issue_request: FHIR-20594 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request asking to resolve an element-name inconsistency: MedicationKnowledge used doseForm for dosage form while Medication still used form, and the accepted resolution was to update the Medication attribute name to doseForm.
initial_application: Jira records the issue as committed in merge a6310682f5c644b348e380c5c295e4af8ca49574. That merge includes implementation commit 8c0d5b260da748e6818ba978ed1c699bd7eeb039, which changed the Medication spreadsheet and numbered Medication examples from form to doseForm but did not update source/medication/medication-example.xml.
additional_context: Medication and MedicationKnowledge are active resources in source/fhir.ini. Current StructureDefinitions already define Medication.doseForm and MedicationKnowledge.definitional.doseForm, and current MedicationKnowledge examples/search parameters use doseForm. The only non-archive Medication/MedicationKnowledge source XML still using form was source/medication/medication-example.xml; archived Medication examples still contain old form tags but were left untouched because they are under source/medication/Archive.
reconciliation: Changed source/medication/medication-example.xml to use doseForm instead of form, aligning the current example with the active Medication StructureDefinition and the FHIR-20594 resolution.
source_changes: source/medication/medication-example.xml: replaced the obsolete <form> element with <doseForm>.
